name: Slack Thread Focus
description: Mute an OpenClaw in a Slack thread with a root-message reaction and resume it with a mention

muteEmoji.label: Mute reaction
muteEmoji.help: Slack reaction name on the root message that mutes the claw.

resumeEmoji.label: Resume reaction
resumeEmoji.help: Optional Slack reaction name that resumes the claw.

botTokenEnv.label: Bot token environment variable
botTokenEnv.help: Name of the environment variable containing the Slack bot token.

botUserIdEnv.label: Bot user id environment variable
botUserIdEnv.help: Optional Slack bot user id. When absent, the plugin resolves it with auth.test.

agentId.label: Agent id override
agentId.help: Optional stable agent id for multi-agent OpenClaw instances.

progressCards.label: Thread progress cards
progressCards.help: Opt-in Block Kit progress, checked against thread focus before every write.

progressAccountId.label: Progress Slack account
progressAccountId.help: Account owned by botTokenEnv. Cards from other accounts are ignored.
